360° Mobile Plant Anti-Collision System

Give operators a stitched surround view and help them spot pedestrians around excavators, forklifts and other compatible mobile plant.

Discuss your project↘

How it works

Surround view

Images from multiple cameras are stitched into a 360° view for the in-cab display, with 2D and 3D viewing modes.

AI pedestrian detection

Onboard video analysis helps identify people around the machine. Confirm coverage and warning behaviour on the selected plant.

Event footage and integration

The documented configuration supports event pre-recording, GPS/BeiDou positioning, 4G connectivity, RTSP streaming and an API for third-party integration.

Configuration and specifications

Video
1080p input and output; 2D/3D views
Recording
Two SD card slots, up to 512 GB each in the documented configuration
Detection range
Up to 10 m in the referenced configuration; confirm on the selected plant and site.
